say.text: Right. Classic TOF has four components: a large, anteriorly malaligned **VSD**, an **overriding aorta**, **infundibular (sub-pulmonary) RVOT obstruction** and **right ventricular hypertrophy**.
The hypertrophy is secondary to chronic systemic pressures.
